definitions.explanation: A formal conversation in which a journalist asks questions, or a meeting to assess a job candidate.

examples.japanese: {記者|きしゃ}がインタビューをした。
{有名|ゆうめい}な{俳優|はいゆう}にインタビューする{機会|きかい}があった。
examples.english: I had the opportunity to interview a famous actor.

examples.japanese: {就職|しゅうしょく}のインタビューは{緊張|きんちょう}した。
examples.english: I was nervous during the job interview.
examples.notes: Note: {面接|めんせつ} is more commonly used for job interviews

notes:
インタビュー primarily refers to media interviews (journalists interviewing people). For job interviews, {面接|めんせつ} is more commonly used.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- インタビューをする: to conduct an interview
- インタビューに{答|こた}える: to respond to an interview
- インタビュー{記事|きじ}: interview article

RELATED WORDS:
- {面接|めんせつ}: job interview, formal interview
- {取材|しゅざい}: news coverage, gathering information

[Register: Neutral]
